verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a filing portal, since agents and mandataires handle many formalities, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows single-item filing, dashboards for tracking filings, and a payment method suited to high-volume filers. Nothing shows the ability to act on many filings at once (batch submission, bulk edits, or a bulk API), and the keyless API probe concerns a separate read-only company-search service, not Guichet unique operations.
